title: Alterna Log 001
text_summary: O.R.C.A. explains Alterna: human city in a crater, 12,000 years ago, built to survive. Liquid crystal fuel. Start of Agent 3's descent.

title: Alterna Log 019
text_summary: The tragic tale: humanity tried to adapt to marine life, failed. Grizz / Mr. Grizz wanted to restore mammals with Fuzzy Ooze.

title: Deep Cut Intro
text_summary: Shiver, Frye and Big Man host Anarchy Splatcast. Callie, Marie (Squid Sisters) and Pearl/Marina (Off the Hook) return in story + DLC Side Order.

title: Side Order - Order Sector
text_summary: Agent 8 wakes in a white virtual world. Cipher / Acht lore. Roguelite spire. Marina's plan to restore order. Pearl drone.

title: X Battle Lore Tip
text_summary: To reach X Battles you must hit S+ in Anarchy. X Power starts ~2000 after 5 placement games. Congrats on your 3-0 +75!
